h: Blessing CEO out of detention, Doris Ogala confirms
p: Relationship coach Blessing CEO has been released from detention, actress Doris Ogala has confirmed. Ogala shared a video on social media showing her on a video call with Blessing shortly after her release.
more: Ogala appeared delighted in the clip as she spoke with Blessing.
Blessing CEO has not yet spoken publicly about her release.
alt: Doris Ogala in a cap, sunglasses and striped top smiling during a video call in a car
